title: Anti-Bolsonaro caravan reported on 1 February but held on 31 January
reason: Out of unit month: the opened account dates the actual multi-city car/bicycle actions to Sunday 31 January. The 1 February publication date does not change event onset.
notes: The report’s more than 1,000 cars in Curitiba are vehicles, not people. The same out-of-month episode is listed in continuations with January as possible owner; no February physical continuation is established.

title: Student actions reported for 30 March, not February
reason: Out of unit month: opened CUT article body identifies publication and student actions on 30 March 2021.
notes: Not treated as evidence of a February event; organizer/origin reported as Rede Brasil Atual (Redação RBA).
